The '''2024 LA Galaxy season''' was the club's [[List of LA Galaxy seasons|29th season]] in [[Major League Soccer]], the top tier of the [[American soccer pyramid]]. [[LA Galaxy]] play their home matches at [[Dignity Health Sports Park]] in the Los Angeles suburb of [[Carson, California|Carson]], [[California]]. The Galaxy opened the season on February 25, 2024, hosting [[Inter Miami CF]].<ref>{{cite news |last1=Baxter |first1=Kevin |title=Galaxy to kick off 2024 season at home against Lionel Messi and Inter Miami |url=https://www.latimes.com/sports/soccer/galaxy/story/2023-12-20/galaxy-2024-schedule-lionel-messi-inter-miami |work=[[Los Angeles Times]] |date=December 20, 2023 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20231225190718/https://www.latimes.com/sports/soccer/galaxy/story/2023-12-20/galaxy-2024-schedule-lionel-messi-inter-miami |archive-date=December 25, 2023 |url-status=live}}</ref>

The Galaxy qualified for the playoffs for the first time since [[2022 LA Galaxy season|2022]] on September 14, and made their first MLS Cup appearance since [[MLS Cup 2014|2014]], winning a record-extending [[MLS Cup 2024|sixth MLS Cup]].

=== U.S. Open Cup ===
{{main|2024 U.S. Open Cup}}
LA Galaxy was not sent to the tournament, but their MLS Next Pro team [[LA Galaxy II]] was sent instead following the deal reached on March 1, 2024.<ref>{{cite news |last1=Carisle |first1=Jeff |title=U.S. Open Cup revamp: Only 8 MLS first teams |url=https://www.espn.com/soccer/story/_/id/39631836/us-open-cup-revamp-feature-just-8-mls-first-teams |access-date=March 1, 2024 |work=[[ESPN|ESPN.com]] |date=March 1, 2024 |language=en}}</ref>
